_comment: Kalshi team code -> the team name ESPN uses (what odds_snapshots stores). Every NFL code below was observed on a live or settled KXNFLGAME ticker on 2026-10-18. Kalshi differs from ESPN's abbreviations in two places: WAS (ESPN WSH) and JAC (ESPN JAX). College codes are added only after a game has been linked by hand or matched by name and checked; a code missing here is never guessed, the game goes to the unmatched list in Settings.
_ncaaf: Added 2026-10-19, each confirmed by the same Eastern date and the same opponent on both feeds (JMU @ App State Oct 22, UMass @ UConn Oct 23, ULM @ Troy Oct 24). One aliased code is enough: the other team still matches by name.
